first_step_test: Two offset cup rims establish the upper and lower cups at their final positions.

source.notes: One generated handmade graphite six-panel contact sheet saved privately; square cells cropped without distortion.

final_elements.name: upper cup rim
final_elements.description: Sketch a shallow oval rim for the upper cup, then a second wider rim below it, offset slightly right.

final_elements.name: upper cup bowl and handle
final_elements.description: Curve down from the upper rim to form its bowl; attach a C handle to its right edge.

final_elements.name: lower cup rim and bowl
final_elements.description: From the lower rim, curve down to form the second cup bowl, keeping it behind the upper cup.

final_elements.name: lower cup handle and saucer
final_elements.description: Attach a C handle to the lower cup and draw a broad saucer oval beneath it.

final_elements.name: two teaspoons
final_elements.description: Lay one narrow teaspoon beside each cup, with oval bowls and slim handles.
